title: SIGMET, convective SIGMET or center weather advisory
description: A SIGMET, convective SIGMET, AIRMET or center weather advisory as text lines, as issued by the Aviation Weather Center or a center weather service unit. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

lines.description: The advisory text lines, upper case, as issued
examples: AREA SEV EMBD TS MOV FROM 25025KT. TOPS ABV FL450.
TORNADOES...HAIL TO 2 IN...WIND GUSTS TO 60KT POSS.
